notes: The existing C1-C5 source-report references and C4 close/match interpretation are retained. New C6/C7 have two independent pilot corroborations and this round's direct checks. Printed locations were verified visually in the published article: pardon paragraph p. 506 (Figure 4B p. 507), new-information percentage p. 505. C6 scores the one-week reading introduced by its paragraph; the printed pair matches the 24-week model and is retained only as a different-wave diagnostic. The unchanged source has the known figure-label assignment error; statement-wise execution continues past it to reach the follow-up functions, without claiming a clean whole-script run. The favourable I4R verdict does not cover these two numerical discrepancies; R7 now requires computational issues without a reproducible alternative.
